local function phase1()
local output=print
local function print(...) output("West course phase 1:",...) end
local self=require('openmw.self')
local core=require('openmw.core')
local util=require('openmw.util')
local camera=require('openmw.camera')
local Actor=require('openmw.types').Actor
local nearby=require('openmw.nearby')
local input=require('openmw.input')
local frame=0
local sampleFrame=nil
local held=false
local function aim(p)
 local t=camera.getViewTransform():inverse()
 local origin=t:apply(util.vector3(0,0,0))
 local f=t:apply(util.vector3(0,0,-1))-origin
 local d=p-origin
 local yaw=math.atan2(f.y*d.x-f.x*d.y,f.x*d.x+f.y*d.y)
 local pitch=math.atan2(f.z,math.sqrt(f.x*f.x+f.y*f.y))-math.atan2(d.z,math.sqrt(d.x*d.x+d.y*d.y))
 local gain=camera.getMode()==camera.MODE.FirstPerson and 1 or 2
 local function units(a) return math.max(-8192,math.min(8192,math.floor(a*5120+.5))) end
 return units(yaw*gain),units(pitch),math.abs(yaw)<.04 and math.abs(pitch)<.04
end
local points={{util.vector3(1467.734,5168.9702,-928),util.vector3(1462.5629,5311.8691,-932),util.vector3(1462.5629,5480.8022,-992)}}
local step=1
return {{engineHandlers={{onFrame=function()
 frame=frame+1
 local down=input.isKeyPressed(input.KEY.F7)
 if down and not held then sampleFrame=frame+3 end
 if not down then sampleFrame=nil end
 held=down
 if sampleFrame and frame>=sampleFrame then print('Substructure camera settled') end
 assert(not Actor.isDead(self),'Player died on joined corridor')
 if frame==5 then
  local armor=0 local axe=false
  for _,item in pairs(Actor.getEquipment(self)) do
   if item.recordId==core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',0x661c1) or item.recordId==core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',0x661c3) then armor=armor+1 end
   if item.recordId==core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',0x90613) then axe=true end
  end
  assert(armor==2 and axe,'Joined chest gear missing') print('Joined corridor ready')
 end
 if step<=#points then
  local p=points[step]
  local d=p-self.position
  if math.sqrt(d.x*d.x+d.y*d.y)<25 then print('Joined corridor waypoint '..step..' reached '..tostring(self.position)) step=step+1
  else
   local x,y,f=aim(util.vector3(p.x,p.y,self.position.z+100))
   print(string.format('Joined corridor waypoint %d aim x=%d y=%d',step,x,y))
   if f then print('Joined corridor waypoint '..step..' facing') end
  end
 end
 if frame%15==0 then
  print('Joined corridor Player '..tostring(self.position)..' health='..Actor.stats.dynamic.health(self).current)
  for _,id in ipairs({{0x176ff,0x17708,0x32a16,0x32a17}}) do
   local obj=nearby.getObjectByFormId(core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',id))
   if obj and obj:isValid() then print('Joined room actor '..id..' pos='..tostring(obj.position)..' dead='..tostring(Actor.isDead(obj))..' health='..Actor.stats.dynamic.health(obj).current) end
  end
 end
end}}}}

end
local function phase2()
local output=print
local function print(...) output("West course phase 2:",...) end
local self=require('openmw.self')
local core=require('openmw.core')
local util=require('openmw.util')
local camera=require('openmw.camera')
local Actor=require('openmw.types').Actor
local nearby=require('openmw.nearby')
local input=require('openmw.input')
local frame=0
local sampleFrame=nil
local held=false
local function aim(p)
 local t=camera.getViewTransform():inverse()
 local origin=t:apply(util.vector3(0,0,0))
 local f=t:apply(util.vector3(0,0,-1))-origin
 local d=p-origin
 local yaw=math.atan2(f.y*d.x-f.x*d.y,f.x*d.x+f.y*d.y)
 local pitch=math.atan2(f.z,math.sqrt(f.x*f.x+f.y*f.y))-math.atan2(d.z,math.sqrt(d.x*d.x+d.y*d.y))
 local gain=camera.getMode()==camera.MODE.FirstPerson and 1 or 2
 local function units(a) return math.max(-8192,math.min(8192,math.floor(a*5120+.5))) end
 return units(yaw*gain),units(pitch),math.abs(yaw)<.04 and math.abs(pitch)<.04
end
return {{engineHandlers={{onFrame=function()
 frame=frame+1
 local down=input.isKeyPressed(input.KEY.F7)
 if down and not held then sampleFrame=frame+3 end
 if not down then sampleFrame=nil end
 held=down
 if sampleFrame and frame>=sampleFrame then print('Substructure camera settled') end
 assert(not Actor.isDead(self),'Player died at ambush door')
 if frame==5 then print('Ambush door ready') end
 local door=nearby.getObjectByFormId(core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',0x17753))
 assert(door and door:isValid(),'Original ambush door missing')
 local x,y=aim(door:getBoundingBox().center)
 print(string.format('Ambush door aim x=%d y=%d',x,y))
 local rayEnd=camera.getViewTransform():inverse():apply(util.vector3(0,0,-150))
 local hit=nearby.castRenderingRay(camera.getPosition(),rayEnd,{{ignore=self}})
 if hit.hitObject==door then print('Ambush door focused') end
 if frame%15==0 then print('Ambush door Player '..tostring(self.position)..' health='..Actor.stats.dynamic.health(self).current) end
end}}}}

end
local function phase3()
local output=print
local function print(...) output("West course phase 3:",...) end
local self=require('openmw.self')
local core=require('openmw.core')
local util=require('openmw.util')
local camera=require('openmw.camera')
local Actor=require('openmw.types').Actor
local nearby=require('openmw.nearby')
local points={{util.vector3(3202.04296875,3371.236572265625,-762.0),util.vector3(3204.3681640625,3529.5302734375,-698.0),util.vector3(3201.693359375,3658.75048828125,-618.0),util.vector3(3202.372802734375,3789.917236328125,-580.0),util.vector3(3197.156494140625,3929.35791015625,-580.0),util.vector3(3046.196044921875,4042.12158203125,-580.0),util.vector3(2939.694580078125,4032.73828125,-580.0),util.vector3(2801.282958984375,4026.095458984375,-580.0),util.vector3(2656.60205078125,3881.384765625,-580.0),util.vector3(2519.03564453125,3888.8876953125,-562.0),util.vector3(2428.0383,3914.7112,-562)}}
local step=1
local ready=false
local frames=0
local timer=0
return {{engineHandlers={{onFrame=function(dt)
 frames=frames+1
 assert(Actor.stats.dynamic.health(self).current>0,'Player died during cavern traversal')
 if frames>=5 and not ready then
  local c,g=false,false
  for _,item in pairs(Actor.getEquipment(self)) do
   if item.recordId==core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',0x661c1) then c=true end
   if item.recordId==core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',0x661c3) then g=true end
  end
  assert(c and g,'Both armor pieces required') ready=true print('Substructure corridor ready')
 end
 if math.abs(camera.getPitch())<.025 then print('Substructure camera level') end
 if step<=#points then
  local d=points[step]-self.position
  local distance=math.sqrt(d.x*d.x+d.y*d.y)
  if distance<25 then print('Substructure waypoint '..step..' reached') step=step+1
  else
   local f=self.rotation:apply(util.vector3(0,1,0))
   local angle=math.atan2(f.y*d.x-f.x*d.y,f.x*d.x+f.y*d.y)
   if math.abs(angle)<.04 then print('Substructure waypoint '..step..' facing') end
   local x=math.max(-8192,math.min(8192,math.floor(angle*5120+.5)))
   local y=math.floor(-camera.getPitch()*5120+.5)
   print(string.format('Substructure waypoint %d aim x=%d y=%d',step,x,y))
  end
 end
 timer=timer+dt
 if timer>1 then timer=0
  print('Substructure corridor Player '..tostring(self.position)..' health='..Actor.stats.dynamic.health(self).current..' pitch='..camera.getPitch())
  for _,id in ipairs({{0x3b526,0x3b513,0x3b543,0x3b518,0x3b51a,0x3b52e}}) do
   local obj=nearby.getObjectByFormId(core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',id))
   if obj and obj:isValid() then print('Substructure encounter '..id..' pos='..tostring(obj.position)..' dead='..tostring(Actor.isDead(obj))..' health='..Actor.stats.dynamic.health(obj).current) end
  end
 end
end}}}}

end
local input=require('openmw.input')
local phases={{phase1,phase2,phase3}}
local n=1
local active=phases[n]()
local held=false
return {{engineHandlers={{onFrame=function(dt)
 local down=input.isKeyPressed(input.KEY.F8)
 if down and not held then n=n+1 assert(phases[n],'Unexpected west observation phase') active=phases[n]() print('West observation phase '..n..' ready') end
 held=down
 active.engineHandlers.onFrame(dt)
end}}}}
